purpose: Explicitly scoped manual-review prompts, never waivers or automatic suppression of upstream findings.

pixel-arcade.intent: Fictional game quest terminal with legible body copy and visible game-state feedback.

protectedFeatures.description: Original CSS gradient and stepped sun/landscape shapes serve pixel illustration, not generic landing-page chrome.
Square buttons, thick borders, and hard-offset shadows communicate 8-bit cartridge controls.
In-world uppercase micro-labels and monospace headlines are meaningful; reading text must still be readable.

contextualReview.reason: Illustrative game environment gradient, not a generic brand/background effect.
Hard 8-bit offset shadows may be intentionally authentic; inspect original screenshot before proposing changes.
In-world game metadata may deliberately use short uppercase forms. This does not exempt unreadable controls.

mandatoryChecks: Keyboard-visible focus and semantic quest state, not merely color.
Legible narrative copy and useful control targets.
Three viewport sizes: 390, 768, 1440; no horizontal overflow.
Other three scenes retain selection, markup, keyboard and interaction flows.
Fictional XP and scenes must not be misrepresented as persistent game data.
